name: Shizu-7132
description: A famous un-registered cultivar from Shizuoka, renowned for its intense and unmistakable aroma of 'sakura-mochi'—a sweet, cherry blossom and glutinous rice scent. It is a natural mutation of Yabukita and offers a very popular and distinct aromatic experience.
plantType: Vigorous, mid-budding bush (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Grows well in Shizuoka and is prized by farmers who specialize in aromatic teas.
processing: Processing for 7132 is all about preserving its signature coumarin compound, which is responsible for the sakura aroma. This requires careful handling and specific steaming and drying parameters.
oxidation: Zero oxidation. The leaves are steamed immediately after harvest.
roasting: A careful final drying roast is applied to enhance and fix the sweet, sakura-like aroma without creating any burnt notes.
versatility: Specialized for Sencha. Its entire value is based on its singular and highly sought-after cherry blossom aroma, so it is not used for other tea styles.

Sencha.Sakura Aroma Sencha: Its sole expression. A green tea processed to maximize its unique sweet cherry blossom and rice cake aroma.

sensory.aroma: Intense sweet cherry blossom (sakura), steamed rice, salty cherry leaf
sensory.flavor: Sweet, floral, with a unique cherry-like flavor and a smooth finish.
sensory.mouthfeel_liquor: Smooth, medium-bodied, and very aromatic. The liquor is a bright green-yellow.
